messages:
Maya: Quick postmortem follow-up from the 03/12 latency spike — I pulled the notes and sketched a proposed action rollup and SLO/SLA changes. Link to postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2024-03-12 :spiral_notepad:

Oliver: thanks. can you paste the action list here? hard to open links from my phone. :iphone:

Maya: sure — keeping it short: 1) KV cache eviction tuning (+owner Priya) 2) Autoscaler policy tweak for queuebuildup (+owner Jonas) 3) Dashboard + alert improvements (+owner Oliver) 4) SLO re-eval & proposal (+owner Maya)

Priya: I can take KV cache tune. timeline: 2 weeks to test in staging, 4 weeks to prod deploy (with canary). planning to run perf test next Tue.

Jonas: autoscaler tweak looks like 1 day to prototype, 3 days to validate with synthetic traffic. I want to add a safety throttle to prevent double-scaling during GC bursts.

Maya: noted. For SLOs: current targets are p50 20ms, p95 120ms, p99 300ms (inference path). Incident showed repeated p95 spikes to ~400ms for ~20m. Proposal: keep p50, tighten p95 to 100ms and raise p99 to 350ms while we improve queuing behavior. Also propose error budget cadence change: move from monthly to 2-week review for critical routes.

Oliver: curious why tighten p95 now vs relax temporarily. worried about chasing noise. suggestion: keep p95 at 120ms but add a "burstable" SLA band that won't trigger immediately — or use a composite SLO: p95 + pct-of-requests-above-250ms < 1%?

Maya: good point. Option A = tighten p95 to 100ms. Option B = keep p95 but add composite check: (p95 < 120ms) AND (pct>250ms < 0.8%). I prefer B as less disruptive while owners fix root causes.

Priya: B sounds pragmatic. we can add both to dashboards as separate panels and see delta for 2 weeks before changing alerting.

Jonas: agree. For dashboard queries, use this as a starting point:
```
service:inference path:generate | latency_percentiles(50,95,99) by route
service:inference | filter latency > 250ms | count() / count(all) as pct_over_250
```
I can wire the panels and add a 15m rolling window alert for pct_over_250 > 1%

Oliver: I'll take dashboard/alert ownership. can you add links to runbooks from the alert so oncall isn't figuring things out during a wakeup?

Jonas: adding runbook links. also adding a blameless note in the runbook about GPU preemption and GC as known modes.

Sam (slo-bot): Incident 3419876500 recorded. Suggested action: schedule SLO review meeting w/eng-platform + SRE + product. Use /slo-schedule to create calendar invite.

Maya: let's meet Thurs 11am for the SLO review. Agenda: review composite check telemetry after 1 week, decide on alerting changes, and pick final SLO values. Priya/Jonas/Oliver to present test results.

Oliver: small ask — can we reset the monthly error budget for the inference-critical bucket given the incident? product and support flagged customer hits. If we reset, we should mark it in the governance doc.

Maya: we should avoid silent resets. propose: 1) request org-level exception documented in the governance sheet with rationale, 2) do a partial reset (50%) to allow emergency deployments but still keep some guardrails. thoughts?

Priya: partial reset + doc makes sense. I'll draft the governance entry and link it in the postmortem doc.

Jonas: timeline recap:
- Priya: KV cache testing starts Tue (staging) — PR by next Fri
- Jonas: autoscaler prototype this week, validation next week
- Oliver: dashboards + alerts this week, add runbook links
- Maya: SLO review Thurs 11am, will bring composite metric samples

Maya: thanks everyone. I'll update the postmortem with these owners/timelines and add the composite SLO panels to the dashboard draft. tagging follow-up owners: @Priya @Jonas @Oliver.

incident-bot: Reminder — please close action items in the postmortem doc once verified. Open items older than 30 days will trigger a reminder to owners.

Oliver: ack. will update once dashboards are live. :thumbsup:

Priya: ack — will post perf test results to the doc after run.

Maya: closing notes: capture recurrence pattern hypothesis (GC + bursty queue on cold start) in the doc, add a small experiment to warm KV cache at rotation, and we'll re-evaluate SLOs after two-week telemetry window.

Sam (slo-bot): SLO review meeting created: Thu 11:00 — invite sent to eng-platform, eng-sre, product.

Maya: thanks — thread done for now.
